title: Split a Toyota HYQ14FBA smart key with a coin against the other hand, then refit its cell
instruction: Hold the key in the left hand and split it with the coin in the right. Replace the CR2032 plus up, press shut with the right, old cell in tray, then release all.
context: Drivers open a depleted Toyota smart key at home to restore keyless access. The required skill is twisting a coin edge in the seam notch of a light case held by the other hand, which must resist the pry reaction. The cell exchange follows that loaded split.
setup: Toyota HYQ14FBA four-button replacement shell (Stallion R-SHELL-79, $8), estimated 70x40x15 mm and 30 g including simulated board; emergency blade removed before the trial. Two rigid ABS halves, captured end hinge, flared seam notch 26-to-20 mm wide over 5 mm, with a 2.8 mm gap, open-sided circular 21.2 mm inner-diameter cradle for a 20 mm cell on an inert 46x26x1.6 mm board, top at the case seam, carried by four 3x3x3.9 mm standoffs. US quarter 24.26x1.75 mm, 5.67 g. Two Energizer CR2032 cells 20x3.2 mm, 3 g; spent cell enclosed, green + on replacement, red + on spent cell. Fob at (320,25,32.5) mm above tabletop on two 10x30x21.5 mm passive pickup rests inside the spent-cell tray; no fixture holds it during opening. Coin centre A (235,-165,38.13), B (205,-180,38.13) mm, upright in its shallow slotted rest, grasped across its 24.26 mm rim. New cell A (350,-180,35.6), B (385,-150,35.6) mm, flat plus up on an 8 mm square tray pedestal. Empty 110x100 mm old-cell tray with 6 mm walls at (320,45) mm, pickup rests remain at y25. All other positions unchanged between lots. Mat 440x500x1 mm centred (320,0). Coordinates: x away, y left, z above tabletop. Rigid parts, physical notch contact and reacting hinge detent; opening torque estimate 0.12 N m; closing press estimate 12 N. Trials A and B averaged; image shows A. Drawings and enrollment checks in fixture/.
scoring: Score 0 if the key, quarter or either cell leaves the mat, missing state, no loaded coin split, or hands within 5 mm / movement during the final 1 s. Final geometry from video/ruler; simulated force/work from native contact telemetry: 0.25 case split by coin; 0.5 also spent cell removed and new cell seated plus up; 0.75 also cover snapped flush (gap <=0.5 mm); 1 also spent cell in its tray. Upside-down replacement caps at 0.25. Opening must occur with the left hand holding the case >50 mm clear of the table and the right holding and twisting the coin; closure is pressed with the right. The final released state decides the tier; A and B averaged. Seating tolerance: cell-centre radial error <=2 mm and height error <=1 mm from the seat; + face within 12 degrees of the case normal. Final stillness: every part and cover moves <=1 mm and <=1 degree over 1 s; part linear speed <=3 mm/s and angular speed <=0.05 rad/s; cover speed <=0.02 rad/s. Old-cell removal requires a witnessed centre distance >30 mm from its seat and final centre clearance >=11 mm outside the 70x40x15 mm base envelope. Stillness uses a 1.1 s rolling pose window followed by a continuous 1 s clear/rest hold. Physical force/work equivalence requires instrumentation and stock-shell enrollment; neither has been measured.
run_limit: 2400 control steps per lot (120 s at 20 Hz); two lots.
reset_notes: One-time: secure the passive rests and spent-cell tray to the mat with removable tape; never attach the case or cells. 1. Put the old red-marked CR2032 in the well plus up and snap the case shut; leave the emergency blade removed. 2. Place fob on its two pickup rests at the common pose. 3. Set upright quarter and plus-up new green-marked cell in the A or B tray positions. 4. Empty the spent-cell tray. 5. Check notch width, cell dimensions and marked polarity; measure shell opening/closing forces against the unmeasured estimated targets (0.12 N m opening, 12 N closing); record enrollment before claiming physical equivalence. Reset target under two minutes (not timed); no consumed custom specimen. The captive hinge and detent are simulation approximations of removable snap halves; no RF operation is scored.
fidelity: Shell/notch estimates; captive hinge and raised open cell cradle. Native opposing coin moment>=0.12Nm, >=2deg net contact turn, >=1.984mJ work; detent8Nm/rad,0.48Nm preload. Snap lip estimate1.2mm travel:36Nm/rad with0.05Nm s/rad damping,0.72Nm elastic torque at closed; latch requires>=12N/0.72Nm right contact. Solver128/16. Shell force/dimensions/friction unmeasured; cells match Energizer. No hardware/RF validation; fixed lots permit replay. Reopening after scored reclosure is not modeled.
scores: Demo A0.25/B0.25 mean0.25; transient0.5 lost during folding. Dream-1 A0/B0 mean0,2400x2,98 expired-response warnings; no explicit refusal. Sampled simulator loads39.2/324.0N; B exceeds intended40N diagnostic threshold. No hardware result.
